en.quote: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
en.riddle: walk before Me, and be thou wholehearted.
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וַיְהִי אַבְרָם בֶּן-תִּשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וְתֵשַׁע שָׁנִים וַיֵּרָא יְהוָה אֶל-אַבְרָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲנִי-אֵל שַׁדַּי הִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנַי, וֶהְיֵה תָמִים.
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי

en.quote: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
en.riddle: Keep My covenant, thou and thy seed.
en.speaker: God

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל-אַבְרָהָם וְאַתָּה אֶת-בְּרִיתִי תִשְׁמֹר אַתָּה וְזַרְעֲךָ אַֽחֲרֶיךָ לְדֹרֹתָֽם
he.speaker: אֱלֹהִים
